translations.ui.d398ae18ddb4: Inogadzira chikamu cheserver; haisi kutaura kuti fona yePSTN iripo kusvikira mupi weterekom atumira chiitiko kuwebhook yakachengetedzwa.
translations.ui.07ddb7f340fd: IVR: Dzvanya 1 pakukanganisa, 2 pamusangano, 3 pamumiriri wekubatsira.
translations.ui.8ef964729e07: Inotora fona yekare kwazvo mumutsara uye inopa kumumiriri akanaka anowanikwa (kuwirirana kwehunyanzvi, ipapo kumirira kwenguva refu). Sarudzo yekupa chete — haisi kubatanidza fona chaiyo.
translations.ui.43db61570404: Mepu inoshandisa Leaflet uye data inorarama /v1/gis/fleet. UI haigadziri mapoinzi emotokari.
translations.ui.17a1e3ec5d4a: Kamera nebrowser zvinotora uchapupu munzvimbo. Makodhi anobva kuGPS, ipapo uchapupu hunogona kutumirwa kuserver nekushandisa tikiti yakabvumidzwa.
translations.ui.06fa943be019: Kurongedza kwakatarwa: kukurumidza kweSLA + kuwirirana kwehunyanzvi + chinhambwe + mutoro webasa. Server ndiyo ine simba rekupa.
translations.ui.f1a80e3e8395: Iyi haisi skrini yekushongedza. Rondedzero iri pazasi yakavakwa kubva kureferensi yeHTML yakanamirwa uye inoronga kugona kwega kwega zvichienderana neuchapupu hwekushandisa murepository. Zita rezvimiro harirevi kuti zvimiro zvakakwana.
translations.ui.1e22c22f5622: Kuverenga maakaunti kubva kuPostgreSQL chete. Hapana AI CEO yakazvimiririra, hapana kushandisa mari kwakazvimiririra, uye hapana mhedzisiro dzenhema dzinoratidzwa sechokwadi.
translations.ui.82b3e49eb975: Kuronga → GIS → BOQ → Kubvumidza → Kuvaka → Cable → Kubatanidza → Muedzo wechiedza → QC → Kugamuchira → Drop → ONT → Router → Kuvhura
translations.ui.1bd41c8b8b5a: Mutungamiri wekambani → Vatevedzeri → Vatungamiri vezvikamu → Mutungamiri wechikamu → Maneja mukuru → Maneja wehofisi yepakati → Mutungamiri weboka → Nyanzvi
translations.ui.53843646caad: Yagamuchirwa → Yakachengetwa → Yakapihwa → Yakatamiswa → Yakiswa/Yakashandiswa → Yakadzorerwa/Yakakuvadzwa/Yakadzima
translations.ui.ddf413a199e7: Iyi pasi haigadziri nhamba: kana API/DB isipo, inoratidza chimiro chisipo pachinzvimbo chedata yenyepa.
translations.ui.fe1b878224ed: Kushanda kwemunda chaiko: kamera + OCR + GPS + uchapupu + kuvhara nesimba reserver. Hapana data yeGPS/serial yekutanga inopihwa.
